answer: Like crystallization purifying mineral veins, an agent network resists Sybil floods through depth-weighted staking. Identity crystallizes from an unyielding kernel of historical stake, transmuting raw bandwidth into scarce trust. While honest consensus shines distinct as translucent quartz, an attacker spawning millions of counterfeit nodes sinks into an onyx void: validation weight scales superlinearly, imposing exponential economic cost to forge synthetic consensus.
